request.prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.

Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.

Create ONE edge-to-edge landscape PNG at exactly 1536×1024. Location-key recipe establish: full environment detail, visible named key light, readable real scale. No collage, borders, text or action scene.

L9 fish_market/key.png. The FISH MARKET FREEZER LANE, a back service lane behind the market's fish section: walk-in freezer doors along both sides, stacks of ice crates, frost on the walls, TWO parked white refrigerated box trucks with rear cargo doors open, cold mist along the ground. A full detailed location reference, camera 1.6 m at one end looking down the 4 m wide lane toward its other end, about 40 m long, a coherent eye-level horizon and normal building proportions. Because the lane is narrow, recess the truck loading bays slightly into the side walls so vehicles do not fill the central walking route. Trucks about 3 m high, plain unbranded bodies, ordinary dark wheels firmly on the lane floor, visible insulated rear doors hinged open and a cool pale interior. Freezer door openings about 2.1 m high, thick insulated panels with attached hinges, rubber seals and long working handles; frost sits around the frames and along the cold wall bases. Stacks of plain blue/white plastic fish crates and ice boxes stand attached to the floor, some with visible rough ice, no printed labels. Concrete floor is damp under the cold-store fixtures, no deep flood water. The key light is WHITE FLUORESCENT TUBES mounted above the freezer doors and along the service canopy; cool grey/navy base, crisp white cold light, no warm sodium or magical aura. THIN COLD WHITE MIST is explicitly part of this scene: low ground-hugging wisps around the doors/crates and truck loading area, clear enough that the floor route, wheel contacts and adult leg lengths remain readable. Never haze over the whole image, no airborne glitter. Exactly TWO TINY GENERIC ADULT WORKER scale figures in plain muted dark work clothes at different middle/far depths on the lane floor, one carrying a small crate at waist level, one checking a closed door handle. Full adult 7.5–8-head proportions, legs about half their height, heads near the shared eye-level horizon; they are 1.78 m compared with 2.1 m freezer doors and 3 m trucks. Do not shrink people to toy-size beside ordinary doors. The approved human front is proportion comparison ONLY: no Jaeha identity, orange vest, T, pencil, notebook or named cast. All signs are blank and trucks have no logos or visible license-plate glyphs. The gate_exit reference is ONLY a reference for drawn vehicles, cold light and wet concrete: do not draw a green billboard, ambulance, red-blue sirens, rescue stripes, construction pit or gate slit. This is a quiet cold-store service lane, before the chapter fight. Do not add fish tanks or a violet cold-storage stairwell; those belong to L12's separate fish-lane view.

Use the attached approved Arc 1 images as the house rendering/material and adult-proportion references, never layouts or named characters to copy. The final attachment is an approved acting-style anchor: match its crisp tapered ink, clean opaque shadow shapes and restrained source-light wash. Draw only the new scene named here. No L6/L7 or other unapproved generated entry is an input.



No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.
